key_points: NHTSA probe into 1.2M Ford vehicles adds near-term recall/legal risk, though impact is still uncertain
Analyst upgrade and improving F-Series production provide a modest offset
New vehicle programs chief appointment is low-to-moderate strategic signal, not an immediate catalyst
Rising transportation costs may pressure margins but are not Ford-specific
Ford's strong pickup/truck demand and high dividend support long-term case, while GM buyback contrast is secondary
